research_question: Does exact request-epoch SFT improve held-out environment-grounded task performance over the same base model and token budget?

arms.name: answer-only-sft
arms.training: same examples and optimizer budget with reasoning and tool arguments masked

controls: no test-set prompt or repository overlap

statistics.report: absolute effect, relative effect, confidence interval, seeds, failures, and exclusions

non_claims: A schema-valid export alone is not evidence that SFT improves a model.
Teacher brand, long reasoning, or a thinking signature is not a quality label.
No preference pair, step reward, or success label may be inferred without versioned evidence.
